I’ve proposed three tiers of stabilizing designs based on the literature:

1. Mutant V1 (Disulfide bond)
   - Y55C, Y190C  
   Rationale: Locks two surface loops, reducing flexibility and increasing thermal stability.

2. Mutant V2 (V1 + Salt Bridge)
   - Y55C, Y190C, D35K, T200E  
   Rationale: Builds on V1 by adding a strategic salt bridge between helix and loop regions to further rigidify the fold.

3. Mutant V3 (V2 + Core Packing)
   - Y55C, Y190C, D35K, T200E, G101A  
   Rationale: In addition to V2’s features, G101A reduces local backbone flexibility in a loop adjacent to the active site, improving core packing without affecting catalytic residues.

I have now generated and folded the first design (Mutant V1). The PDB file is available at:
• predicted_structures/mutant_v1.pdb.pdb
